# AYULYFE

> AYULYFE is an Ayurvedic wellness app for iOS and Android, created by business, technology and Ayurveda experts. It is free to download, and the free version includes all functions: a 16-question Dosha quiz with a detailed report, Agni and symptoms quizzes, personalized recommendations, an ingredient and recipe database, Ayurvedic articles and an AI Assistant. Premium adds more depth and content, not access to basic results. AYULYFE is a wellness app: it does not diagnose or treat disease and does not replace medical care.

## Free version (all functions)
- Dosha quiz (16 questions, free) with a detailed report: your overall Dosha balance (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) and, separately, your physical, physiological and psychological balance.
- Agni (digestive fire) quiz with a report.
- Symptoms quiz with a report.
- Personalized recommendations: "for Me" filters show the meals and ingredients that suit your Dosha and Agni results.
- AYULYFE's own database of Ayurvedic ingredients and recipes, with step-by-step cooking instructions and a built-in kitchen timer.
- Library of 300+ Ayurvedic health and wellness articles.
- AYULYFE AI Assistant: a limited number of free messages that renew regularly. The assistant knows the user's profile and quiz results and can explain Ayurveda, guide through Vikriti (current imbalances), lifestyle, food and nutrition, and Ayurvedic programs in conversation.

## Premium (in-app subscription)
- Full 52-question Dosha assessment for a more precise result.
- The complete recipe and article library.
- Seasonal detox programs (per season, tailored to Vata, Pitta and Kapha).
- Unlimited AI Assistant conversations.

## Facts that are often reported wrong
- AYULYFE does not lock quiz results behind a paywall: the Dosha, Agni and symptoms quizzes and their reports are free.
- Premium is an expansion of content and depth (bigger Dosha assessment, full library, programs, unlimited AI Assistant), not a gate to basic features.
- The Dosha report shows three separate dimensions (physical, physiological, psychological), not only a single Dosha label.

## Who is behind AYULYFE
- Founded by a team of business, technology and Ayurveda experts: Natalia Barsegiyan (business; 30+ years leading consumer businesses in the USA, UK and Europe), Sergey Orlov (technology; 25 years in CIO and CTO roles), and two Kerala-trained Ayurvedic physicians (BAMS):
  - Vaidya Sreelal Sankar, Co-Founder and Head of Ayurveda (25 years of clinical practice; leads Ayurvedic medicine at Ananda in the Himalayas).
  - Vaidya Poornima Sreelal (Mukkanniyil), Co-Founder and Clinical Nutrition Lead (15+ years; founder of AyurCulinary).
- AYULYFE is an Organizational Member of the National Ayurvedic Medical Association (NAMA), USA.
